title: Consolidate usage bands and deprecate legacy metered tiers — launch coordination for billing, sales, and release notes
creator: Ravi Patel
description: Goal: Replace five legacy metered tiers with a simpler set of usage bands (Nano, Starter, Growth, Scale) and migrate existing SKUs to the new bands. This ticket coordinates launch activities across billing, sales, legal, support, and engineering so the migration is smooth for customers, billing is accurate, and release notes communicate changes clearly. Scope includes SKU mapping, limit enforcement timeline, billing migration job, release notes copy, sales enablement materials, and a staged enforcement plan with a soft opt-in for impacted customers.
acceptance_criteria: SKU mapping table published and validated by Finance and Billing
Migration script tested on staging and reconciled within 0.1% with current invoices
Customer-facing release notes drafted and approved by Legal and Support
Sales enablement deck and FAQ published in Drive and distributed to AE group
Console displays new usage band names and updated limits in the account settings
Rollback and fallback steps documented and tested for the first 48 hours after cutover
implementation_notes: Phase 1 (Design & Validation): finalize usage-band thresholds and billing price points; Finance approves revenue projection. Phase 2 (Engineering & QA): implement SKU translation layer, add feature-flagged enforcement, add migration job; run reconciliation job on historical data. Phase 3 (Comms & GTM): produce release notes, update docs, ship sales scripts, schedule webinars for top 50 customers. Phase 4 (Cutover & Monitor): run migration job in low-traffic window, monitor invoices and Console quota metrics; open fast-response channel for billing escalations.
